news.title: Hilarious Glimpse Unveiled for Shiva Kandukuri's 'Talcum Powder'
news.summary: The makers of Talcum Powder have released a hilarious first glimpse into the comedy-drama starring Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander. Directed by Sainath Ponna and presented by Raj Kandukuri, the film follows a drug peddler named Bunty while drawing interest from cops and the mafia. The feature is scheduled to hit theaters on November 13, 2026.
body: The makers of the upcoming Telugu film *Talcum Powder* have officially released its first promotional glimpse, offering audiences a humorous preview of the project. Headlined by Shiva Kandukuri and female lead Drishika Chander, the film is directed by Sainath Ponna and presented by notable producer Raj Kandukuri.

The newly released video introduces a character named Bunty, a drug peddler caught in a chaotic situation involving both law enforcement and the drug mafia. Alongside the leads, the glimpse features appearances by Venkatesh Maha, A Jeevan Kumar, and presenter Raj Kandukuri, sparking immediate curiosity among film enthusiasts.
On the technical front, the project features a musical score composed by Osho V. Cinematography is handled by GV Ajay Kumar, while Surya Ponnapalli takes charge of the editing.
Fans eagerly awaiting the feature can mark their calendars, as *Talcum Powder* is locked in for a grand theatrical release on November 13, 2026.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Praises Fahadh Faasil Starrer 'Dont Trouble The Trouble'
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu shared high praise for the upcoming film Dont Trouble The Trouble after attending a private screening. Directed by Shashank and produced by Karthikeya and Shobu, the movie features Fahadh Faasil and young actor Ssara. The project is set for release on October 2, following a pre-release event attended by NTR.
body: Superstar Mahesh Babu has expressed immense appreciation for the upcoming movie *Dont Trouble The Trouble* following a private viewing ahead of its public debut. The actor took to social media to describe the feature as a beautifully complete, well-crafted, and deeply moving experience that carries a rare sense of warmth.

Marking SS Rajamouli's son Karthikeya's debut as a producer alongside Shobu, the project is directed by Shashank. The film stars Malayalam actor Fahadh Faasil alongside young child actor Ssara, whose dynamic performances drew glowing remarks from Mahesh Babu, who commended Fahadh for his continuous evolution and experimentation as an actor.

The project has generated significant industry buzz, bolstered by a pre-release event attended by actor NTR. *Dont Trouble The Trouble* is officially scheduled to land in cinemas on October 2, setting the stage for audiences to experience the film over the holiday weekend.

Meanwhile, Mahesh Babu is currently busy shooting for his next highly anticipated collaboration with director SS Rajamouli, tentatively titled *Varanasi*, which is slated for release on April 7, 2027.

news.title: Telugu Release of Nivin Pauly and Soori's 'Sanchari' Postponed
news.summary: The Telugu version of the Nivin Pauly and Soori starrer, titled Sanchari, has been postponed from its scheduled October 1 simultaneous release. Directed by Ram, the Tamil original titled Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai faced a temporary delay due to a title issue. Producers have promised to announce a fresh arrival date shortly.
body: The scheduled simultaneous release of the Telugu version of *Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai*, titled *Sanchari*, has been pushed to a later date. The film features Nivin Pauly following his industry hit *Bheema Kudumba Unit*, alongside Kollywood actor Soori in a prominent role.

According to the latest updates from the makers, the release has been temporarily put on hold due to an ongoing title issue. A revised release date will be officially communicated to audiences in the near future.
Directed by Ram and produced by Suresh Kamatchi under V House Productions, the multi-starrer also features actress Anjali. Musical compositions for the project are scored by Yuvan Shankar Raja.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses ₹150 Crore Worldwide, Looks to Extended Weekend for Recovery
news.summary: Nani's starrer The Paradise has crossed the ₹150 crore mark globally following its first week in theatres. While the film opened to record figures, collections have slowed down across certain regions, prompting active promotional tours by the lead actor. The upcoming long weekend provides a vital window for the movie to achieve its break-even targets.
body: Nani's action drama The Paradise has successfully completed its first week at the global box office, crossing the ₹150 crore milestone worldwide. The film initially launched with record-breaking numbers, securing the biggest opening of Nani's career to date. However, collections have experienced a noticeable slowdown in various territories, particularly across Andhra Pradesh following the initial weekend.

Despite the dip in specific regions, the Nizam territory remains a strong pillar for the movie, maintaining decent numbers and successfully breaking even. To support the theatrical run, Nani has kept up his promotional momentum, actively touring Andhra Pradesh to encourage larger audiences to experience the film on the big screen.

The makers are banking on an upcoming extended weekend to boost box-office numbers. With Gandhi Jayanti falling on a Friday, the film gains an extra holiday advantage that could provide the necessary momentum. Even as fresh theatrical competition arrives in the form of Simga and Don't Trouble The Trouble, this holiday window remains critical for securing profits in struggling territories.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Slays on Filmfare Cover While Gear Up for Next Cinematic Outing
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu has captured attention with her latest appearance on the Filmfare cover, showcasing multiple striking outfits. On the professional front, the actress is focusing on her upcoming projects following a challenging box-office phase in 2026. She is currently shooting for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, playing ACP Komal Sharma.
body: Taapsee Pannu has once again commanded the spotlight with her latest feature on the Filmfare cover. The actress displayed a diverse range of high-fashion looks, appearing in a sky-blue sequin mini dress paired with a golden potli, alongside styled curly hair. Her wardrobe for the feature also spanned a printed teal co-ord set, a shimmering gold gown, a royal blue slit dress, and a chic white bandeau set with a bubble hem.

While her editorial presence continues to thrive, Pannu's cinematic journey in 2026 has faced hurdles at the box office with the underperformance of both Advocate Raavi and Gandhari. Despite these setbacks, the actress remains firmly focused on her upcoming slate of work.

Pannu is currently busy filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she steps into the role of ACP Komal Sharma. Fans and industry watchers are eagerly anticipating this upcoming project as a strong cinematic comeback for the versatile performer.

news.title: Akshay Kumar and Priyadarshan's Crime Thriller Haiwaan Ends Box Office Run Below Rs. 10 Crores
news.summary: Akshay Kumar's crime thriller Haiwaan, directed by Priyadarshan and co-starring Saif Ali Khan, has wrapped up its theatrical run with a lifetime collection of Rs. 9 crore nett. The film faced pre-release criticism for being a remake of a ten-year-old Malayalam movie and suffered from weak word-of-mouth. Consequently, director Priyadarshan has reportedly decided to steer clear of non-comedy projects with the actor in the future.
body: The crime thriller Haiwaan, starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan under the direction of Priyadarshan, has emerged as a major disappointment at the box office. The film opened to a lukewarm response of just over Rs. 2.5 crore nett on its first day, subsequently drawing a first-weekend collection of Rs. 6.7 crore nett before experiencing a sharp collapse.

The project finished its theatrical run with lifetime collections halting at a startling Rs. 9 crore nett. For a cinematic venture led by a prominent star, these financial figures have fallen significantly short of expectations. The film faced criticism even prior to its release, largely because it served as an official remake of the Malayalam feature Oppam, which debuted a decade ago.

Weak audience word-of-mouth further hindered its commercial appeal, limiting its reach in theatres. The disappointing outcome has reportedly prompted director Priyadarshan to avoid venturing into non-comedy films with Akshay Kumar moving forward, sending ripples through the industry.

news.title: Ravi Teja's Irumudi Claims Global No. 1 Spot on Netflix Following Strong Theatrical Run
news.summary: Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja's starrer Irumudi has achieved massive digital success, climbing to the global No. 1 position for non-English movies on Netflix. The film, directed by Shiva Nirvana and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, amassed over 6.8 million views on the platform. This streaming milestone follows a profitable theatrical run that yielded strong returns for producers and distributors.
body: Irumudi, featuring Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja in the lead role, is continuing its successful streak following a profitable theatrical run. Directed by Shiva Nirvana and backed by producers Mythri Movie Makers, the film delivered strong numbers at the box office, benefiting producers, distributors, and exhibitors alike alongside co-stars Priya Bhavani Shankar and Baby Nakshatra.

After concluding its cinema run, the film transitioned to Netflix on the 18th of the month and quickly found a massive digital audience. Irumudi has officially climbed to the No. 1 position globally among non-English films on the streaming platform.

The project has registered a viewership of over 6.8 million so far. This rare achievement highlights a dual success story where a film maintains strong audience resonance across both large-screen theatrical releases and digital home viewing.

news.title: Shiva Kandukuri Leads New-Age Crime Dramedy 'Talcum Powder'
news.summary: National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri is presenting the new-age crime dramedy Talcum Powder, starring Shiva Kandukuri and directed by Sainath Ponna. The project has launched its promotional campaign with an introductory glimpse titled The First Sprinkle, setting a November 13 theatrical release.
body: National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri is backing a fresh cinematic venture under the Dharmapatha Creations banner titled Talcum Powder. The film stars Shiva Kandukuri in the lead role and Drishika Chander as the female lead, with writing and direction handled by Sainath Ponna.

The project has officially commenced its promotional rollout with the release of its first glimpse, titled The First Sprinkle. The introductory video centers on Bunty, a drug peddler who finds himself cornered by both the police and a group of goons after committing an inadvertent mistake.

Promising an eccentric world of crime, comedy, and unexpected narrative twists, the film features a contemporary storytelling approach. The supporting cast includes appearances by Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar, among others.

On the technical front, the movie features cinematography by GV Ajay Kumar, music composition by Osho V, and editing by Surya Ponnapalli. Talcum Powder is scheduled to arrive in theaters on November 13.

news.title: Superstar Mahesh Babu Appreciates Fahadh Faasil Starrer 'Don't Trouble The Trouble'
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has shared high praise for the upcoming straight Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble after attending a special screening. Directed by Shashank Yeleti and presented by S.S. Rajamouli, the film is slated to hit screens on October 2.
body: Ahead of its theatrical release, Fahadh Faasil's straight Telugu film Don't Trouble The Trouble has received a significant endorsement from Superstar Mahesh Babu. Following a special screening, the actor took to social media to express his appreciation for the feature.

Mahesh Babu described the movie as a well-crafted, happy experience that successfully balances thorough entertainment with deep emotional resonance. He specifically lauded the on-screen pairing of Fahadh Faasil and Ssara, noting Fahadh's continuous artistic evolution.

Directed by debutant Shashank Yeleti, the project is produced by Shobu Yarlagadda, Prasad Devineni, and S.S. Karthikeya under Arka Media Works and Showing Business, with S.S. Rajamouli presenting. The film marks Karthikeya's maiden production venture.
Don't Trouble The Trouble is scheduled for a theatrical release on October 2, building anticipation following promotional backing from prominent industry figures including Junior NTR and Mahesh Babu.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti Confirms Hindi-Telugu Bilingual With Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar
news.summary: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has confirmed that he will direct a Hindi-Telugu bilingual tentatively titled Mahakaal, starring Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar. The director clarified that the mythological project is currently in early pre-production and has no connection to Sanjay Leela Bhansali.
body: Director Chandoo Mondeti has addressed recent industry speculation, confirming his next venture will be a Hindi-Telugu bilingual tentatively titled Mahakaal. The project brings together Rana Daggubati and Bollywood superstar Akshay Kumar in lead roles.

According to the director, discussions for the film materialized after meetings in Mumbai where Rana requested a compelling narrative, leading to the selection of a mythological subject set against the backdrop of Ujjain. Mondeti clarified that while Karan Johar is slated to produce the Hindi version, the Telugu production house is yet to be finalized.

Addressing rumors linking filmmaker Sanjay Leela Bhansali to the story, Mondeti firmly stated that the project has no connection to Bhansali, noting that he handles both the story and direction himself, though he remains in talks with Bhansali regarding a separate concept.
The project is currently in its initial phase, with the team focusing on story discussions, technician selection, and early pre-production steps.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Unveil Historical Context Behind 'Ranabaali'
news.summary: The team behind 'Ranabaali' has shared another episode from their documentary-style promotional series, focusing on historical elements. Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna discussed how British colonial infrastructure was utilized to transport resources out of India. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the movie is scheduled to release on October 16.
body: The makers of 'Ranabaali' have adopted a unique promotional strategy by rolling out a four-episode documentary-style series to prepare audiences for the film's thematic backdrop. Following an initial episode that detailed a man-made famine in the Madras Presidency, the second installment features lead actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna discussing lesser-known historical narratives.

During the latest video presentation, the actors highlighted that the British railway system in India was initially developed to rapidly move local resources such as grains, spices, cotton, and gold directly to ports. Vijay Deverakonda noted that conventional history syllabi omitted these crucial details because historical records were largely compiled from a colonial perspective.

Adding her perspective, Rashmika Mandanna shared that uncovering these in-depth historical realities deeply impacted her understanding of the era. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, 'Ranabaali' aims to present these compelling themes on the big screen when it arrives in cinemas on October 16.

The promotional documentary series continues to offer clarity on the narrative scope of the film, assuring viewers that the project centers on specific historical hardships rather than a traditional freedom struggle framework.

news.title: Maadhav's Debut Film 'Maremma' Locks Dual OTT Release Date
news.summary: The rural drama 'Maremma', starring debutant Maadhav Bhupathiraju, is heading to digital platforms. The film will stream on both Aha and Amazon Prime Video starting October 9, 2026. Directed by Manchala Nagaraj, the movie originally opened in cinemas on September 10, 2026.
body: Rural drama 'Maremma', which marked the acting debut of Maadhav Bhupathiraju—nephew of Tollywood star Ravi Teja—is making its transition to digital platforms. Following its theatrical debut on September 10, 2026, the film is gearing up for an imminent streaming premiere.

According to recent updates, streaming platforms Aha and Amazon Prime Video have secured the digital rights for the project. An official announcement confirming the dual platform release date of October 9, 2026, is anticipated shortly.

Directed by Manchala Nagaraj and produced by Mayur Reddy Bandaru, 'Maremma' features an ensemble cast including Deepa Balu, Vikas Vasishta, Vinod Kumar, V.S. Rupa Lakshmi, and Dayanand Reddy in pivotal roles. The film's musical score was composed by Prashanth R. Vihari and Bipradeep Dutta.
The digital release provides audiences who missed the theatrical run an opportunity to watch the debutant's rural drama from home across multiple streaming services.

news.title: Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's 'Fauji' Postponed Indefinitely
news.summary: The release date for Prabhas and Hanu Raghavapudi's upcoming film 'Fauji' has been postponed indefinitely, with the makers in no rush to set a new schedule. Insiders report that significant portions of the shoot remain pending, requiring Prabhas to dedicate extensive working days amidst his other commitments. While an official new release date is unlikely to be announced on the actor's birthday, promotional material may still be released.
body: The historical action drama 'Fauji', starring Prabhas and directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, has encountered further scheduling adjustments. Following multiple delays, its tentative December 3 release date has now been shelved indefinitely as production continues.

Sources close to the production indicate that the makers are prioritizing completion of the remaining shooting schedule before committing to a fresh premiere date. A substantial portion of the film remains unfinished, and Prabhas is reportedly required to allot over 60 working days to wrap up his sequences.

Given the actor's parallel commitments, including Sandeep Reddy Vanga’s 'Spirit', completing these required shooting days could extend over the next four months, leaving the production team without a firm timeline for wrap-up. Consequently, insiders suggest that the upcoming birthday of Prabhas on October 23 will not feature a release date announcement, though a new promotional poster or material may be shared with fans instead.

The ambitious project also features Imanvi in the female lead role, marking her feature film debut. The cautious approach by the production house underscores the care being taken to ensure the remaining schedule is executed without rushing the post-production process.

news.title: Rapid OTT Releases for Karthi's Films Raise Concerns Among Trade Analysts
news.summary: Actor Karthi's spy thriller 'Sardar 2' has arrived on Amazon Prime Video just 21 days after its theatrical release, following an underperforming box-office run. This marks his second quick digital premiere this year, following the Pongal release 'Vaa Vaathiyar', which hit streaming platforms in just 14 days. Trade analysts warn that these shortened theatrical windows could negatively impact advance bookings and audience motivation to visit cinemas.
body: The trend of rapid digital premieres for major star vehicles is stirring debate within the Tamil film industry, particularly following the swift OTT arrival of Karthi's latest projects. The spy thriller sequel 'Sardar 2' made its debut on Amazon Prime Video on October 1, marking a theatrical window of just 21 days after struggling to attract large crowds in halls.

This quick transition follows a similar trajectory seen earlier in the year with Karthi's Pongal release, the comedy-action film 'Vaa Vaathiyar'. Despite launching during a prime festive holiday window, that film underperformed at the box office and was rushed to Amazon Prime Video in five languages merely 14 days after its theatrical opening.

Traditionally, major commercial releases maintain an exclusive theatrical window of four to eight weeks to allow distributors and cinema owners sufficient time to recover investments through ticket sales. However, consecutive quick digital releases for a prominent star have alarmed trade analysts who monitor exhibition health.

Exhibition sector observers caution that shortening the theatrical window to two or three weeks for underperforming titles trains audiences to skip cinema visits, anticipating a quick home release. Such a shift threatens to diminish opening-weekend footfalls and advance bookings, compounding challenges for theatre owners striving to maintain sustainable box-office revenues.

news.title: Talcum Powder Glimpse Unveils A Quirky Drug-Themed Dramedy
news.summary: The teaser for Talcum Powder introduces a humorous take on a drug underworld, starring Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander. Directed by Sainath Ponna and produced by National Award-winner Raj Kandukuri, the film is slated for a theatrical release on November 13.
body: The newly released glimpse of Talcum Powder offers audiences a fresh look at a comedy-driven dramedy set against the backdrop of a drug network. Rather than leaning into the dark, bloody tropes typically associated with crime thrillers, director Sainath Ponna adopts a lighthearted and imaginative narrative style.

Headlined by Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander, the project features a series of eccentric characters and sticky situations. Shiva Kandukuri's comic timing and snappy one-liners anchor the teaser, immediately establishing the project's playful tone as his character navigates interactions with dealers and peddlers.

Backed by National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri—known for his work on films like Pelli Choopulu and Mental Madhilo—the movie aims to deliver wholesome entertainment. With its distinct visual style and unconventional premise, the film has built considerable intrigue ahead of its theatrical debut.
Fans will not have to wait long to see how the narrative unfolds on the big screen. Talcum Powder is officially scheduled to hit theatres on November 13.

news.title: Karan Johar Announces Ninth And Final Season Of Koffee With Karan
news.summary: Popular celebrity chat show Koffee With Karan is coming to an end with its upcoming ninth season, host Karan Johar has announced. The final season will stream on JioHotstar starting October 14, closing out a 22-year run defined by candid confessions and pop culture conversations.
body: One of Indian entertainment's most recognizable and talked-about talk shows is drawing to a close. Host and filmmaker Karan Johar has officially announced that Koffee With Karan will conclude after its upcoming ninth season, bringing a definitive end to the long-running series.

Reflecting on the milestone, Johar shared an emotional personal message, recalling early conversations about hosting the program with his late father, Yash Johar. Since its debut in 2004, the show has completed eight seasons and 161 episodes, establishing itself as a fixture of celebrity culture marked by rapid-fire rounds, iconic coffee hampers, and headline-making moments.

Throughout its run, the programme frequently drew discussion and scrutiny regarding its guest lists and industry dynamics. Anticipation is high for the final outing, with notable names such as Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda, and Allu Arjun expected to appear on the couch.
The ninth and final season is scheduled to begin streaming on JioHotstar on October 14, offering viewers a last chance to tune into the famous format.

news.title: Salman Khan And Vamshi Paidipally's Action Film Assembles A Heavyweight Cast
news.summary: The upcoming action film starring Salman Khan and directed by Vamshi Paidipally has added a substantial supporting cast, featuring Nayanthara as the female lead. Reportedly titled Monster and produced by Dil Raju, the big-scale project is targeting an Eid 2027 release.
body: The upcoming action collaboration between actor Salman Khan and director Vamshi Paidipally is shaping up as a massive cinematic endeavor, bolstered by a prominent ensemble cast. Reportedly carrying the title Monster, the project marks the first on-screen pairing of Salman Khan with female lead Nayanthara.

The mounting scale of the production is further highlighted by its supporting roster, which includes industry veterans and notable actors such as Arvind Swamy, Jackie Shroff, Anil Kapoor, Rajpal Yadav, Ronit Roy, and Seema Biswas. Early reports indicate that Salman Khan will essay the role of an unorthodox cop within the narrative.

Bankrolled by producer Dil Raju under the banner of Sri Venkateswara Creations, the film is being mounted on a grand scale with numerous elaborate action set-pieces planned throughout the schedule. Production is currently halfway complete.
With high anticipation surrounding the director-star combination and its extensive supporting lineup, the team has locked in a theatrical release targeting Eid 2027.

news.title: Actor Nani Hits Andhra Pradesh to Drive The Paradise Box Office Numbers
news.summary: Actor Nani has traveled to Andhra Pradesh to boost the box office performance of The Paradise during the extended holiday period. Following a dip in regional occupancy, the actor is engaging directly with fans through a promotional tour across multiple cities.
body: Actor Nani has arrived in Andhra Pradesh to ramp up promotions for his film The Paradise, stepping in to counter a recent slowing of theater occupancy in the region. The team hopes to capitalize on the extended holiday week by re-energizing audience turnout.

Arriving in Gannavaram, Nani's promotional itinerary includes direct fan interactions in key cities such as Vijayawada, Guntur, and Ongole. While the feature enjoyed a solid opening and initial momentum, the subsequent drop in local ticket sales prompted the makers to deploy direct outreach.

With the crucial extended holiday period offering a fresh window to pull crowds back to theaters, the team is banking on Nani's personal presence to generate renewed buzz and improve box office returns.

news.title: Ravi Teja Starrer Irumudi Claims Top Spot on Netflix Global Non-English Chart
news.summary: Ravi Teja's Irumudi has secured the number one position on Netflix's Global Top 10 list for non-English films. Directed by Shiva Nirvana, the Telugu feature recorded 3.4 million views during its first full week on the streaming platform.
body: Irumudi, starring Ravi Teja, has achieved international streaming success by topping Netflix’s Global Top 10 list for non-English films during the week of September 21 to 27. The Telugu production brought in 3.4 million views across the seven-day period.

Following its platform debut on September 18, the film accumulated an identical 3.4 million views in its initial three days, bringing its total to 6.8 million views since its OTT release according to reported figures. The project is directed by Shiva Nirvana and features Sai Kumar alongside Priya Bhavani Shankar.

The narrative follows a troubled father embarking on a spiritual journey connected to his family and daughter. Netflix made the title available in Telugu audio alongside Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada versions, building on the film's prior theatrical run.

news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee’s Guinness Record-Holder ‘Raaka’ Eyed for a Two-Part Release
news.summary: Makers of Allu Arjun's upcoming high-budget spectacle Raaka, directed by Atlee, are reportedly considering splitting the film into two parts. Originally planned as a single feature under Sun Pictures, the ambitious project may now release its first installment in December 2027.
body: Allu Arjun's highly anticipated global project Raaka, directed by filmmaker Atlee, is undergoing significant planning regarding its theatrical rollout. While the movie initially grabbed headlines by entering the Guinness Book of Records, recent industry speculation suggests a major shift in the distribution strategy.

Insiders indicate that the makers have decided to divide the high-budget venture into two parts due to its massive financial scale. The first installment is currently anticipated to hit screens in December 2027, with the subsequent chapter slated for a 2028 release. Originally conceptualized as a single feature, the expansive production scope prompted the pivot.

The prestigious project, bankrolled by Sun Pictures, features Deepika Padukone as the female lead alongside Mrunal Thakur, Rashmika Mandanna, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lakshmi in crucial roles. Music for the film is composed by Sai Abhyannkar. Allu Arjun is slated to appear in multiple getups and across diverse timelines, building immense curiosity among movie lovers worldwide.

news.title: Nani’s ‘The Paradise’ Crosses Nizam Breakeven in Six Days
news.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela's rural drama The Paradise has successfully crossed its breakeven milestone in the Nizam region within six days of release. Despite mixed early word-of-mouth reviews, the film's local share has reached approximately Rs. 30 crore with a worldwide gross of around Rs. 170 crore.
body: The theatrical journey of Nani and director Srikanth Odela's latest collaboration, The Paradise, has achieved an important regional milestone. Despite carrying mixed talk following its premiere shows, the movie successfully crossed its financial breakeven mark in the Nizam territory, inclusive of GST, within its first six days.

According to box-office figures, the film's Nizam share stands at roughly Rs. 30 crore, bolstered by a Tuesday contribution of around Rs. 83 lakh. On a global scale, The Paradise has accumulated a total gross of approximately Rs. 170 crore so far during its theatrical run.

As the feature enters a crucial weekday phase, its upcoming performance will dictate how far it can stretch its box-office numbers. Lead actor Nani has been actively promoting the project across Andhra Pradesh. Produced by SLV Cinemas with music by Anirudh Ravichander, the film features Kayadu Lohar, Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, and Sonali Kulkarni in pivotal roles.

news.title: Anirudh Ravichander Delivers Fanboy Tribute with ‘Jailer 2’ Track ‘One Name’
news.summary: Composer Anirudh Ravichander has released 'One Name', the latest track from Rajinikanth's anticipated sequel Jailer 2. Designed as a celebration of the Superstar, the song aims to reinvigorate pre-release hype following a relatively muted response to the film's earlier musical releases.
body: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander has unveiled 'One Name', the newest single from the upcoming Rajinikanth starrer Jailer 2. Following a lukewarm response to the film's initial musical drops, the new track arrives at a critical juncture to help build pre-release momentum.

While differing from the massive mass anthem 'Hukum' from the original Jailer, 'One Name' serves as an ode to Superstar Rajinikanth. Reviewers and fans have noted that Anirudh’s personal admiration for the veteran actor shines through in the arrangement, functioning essentially as an unabashed fanboy tribute.

The release of the track gives the project a vital boost as the makers prepare for their hefty theatrical targets. With expectations running high due to the massive success of their previous association, the promotional campaign now looks toward upcoming assets like Nora Fatehi's special song and the official theatrical trailer to cement audience buzz.

news.title: Real-Life Cinema Passion Inspires Debut Producer for Rural Drama ‘Anakapalli’
news.summary: First-time producer Kandregula Naidu's unusual path to cinema—sparked by an inability to buy tickets for Prabhas' Mirchi—has generated unique local buzz for his debut film Anakapalli. Directed by Khagesh Tammineni and co-produced by Trinadha Rao Nakkina, the rustic rural entertainer releases on October 2.
body: The Telugu film industry often welcomes unconventional entries, but debutant producer Kandregula Naidu's entry into filmmaking stands out for its sheer passion. Naidu recounts that his journey began when he and his family were unable to secure tickets for a housefull screening of Prabhas' Mirchi in Anakapalli, prompting him to impulsively declare he would buy the theatre—a venue he now owns and is using to premiere his own film.

Transitioning from real-life success in real estate, which he attributes to inspiration from Ravi Teja's film Bhageeratha and local community support, Naidu is putting his full weight behind the promotions of Anakapalli. His candid storytelling and background have successfully cultivated organic, positive curiosity for the upcoming rural project.

Billed as a raw rural entertainer, Anakapalli follows a young protagonist entangled in organized crime under a ruthless mob leader whose life shifts upon falling in love. The film stars Vikram Sahidev, Sandhya Vasishta, and Tarak Ponnappa, with direction by Khagesh Tammineni and story-screenplay by noted filmmaker Trinadha Rao Nakkina. It hits the big screen on October 2 under the Bhavya Sri Movie Makers and Nakkina Narratives banners.

news.title: Jr NTR Confirms Full Recovery From Shoulder Surgery, Prepares for Dragon Filming
news.summary: Jr NTR has announced his complete recovery from a shoulder injury and subsequent surgery, clearing the path for him to resume shooting. The actor will soon join the sets of Prashanth Neel's directorial project, Dragon, before moving on to Trivikram's mythological film.
body: Tollywood actor Jr NTR has officially announced that he has fully recovered from his shoulder injury and the subsequent surgery he underwent in Secunderabad. Speaking at a recent public appearance for the pre-release event of "Don't Trouble The Trouble," the actor confirmed to fans and media that he is completely healthy following a dedicated regimen of physiotherapy.

With his health restored, Jr NTR is set to rejoin the production of "Dragon," directed by Prashanth Neel. Filming for the project had previously been paused to accommodate the actor's medical procedure and recovery period. Director Prashanth Neel is reportedly aiming to wrap up shooting for the venture by February.

Makers have slated "Dragon" for a theatrical release in June 2027. Following the completion of this project, Jr NTR is slated to begin work on a proposed mythological feature directed by Trivikram, which is reportedly centered on Lord Murugan and expected to commence production after March.

news.title: Jr NTR's Promotional Support Boosts Visibility for Don't Trouble The Trouble
news.summary: Fahadh Faasil starrer Don't Trouble The Trouble has received a significant promotional boost following an appearance by Jr NTR. Produced by SS Karthikeya, the content-driven project heads toward its October 2 release relying on word-of-mouth to sustain theatrical momentum.
body: The upcoming film "Don't Trouble The Trouble," starring Fahadh Faasil and produced by SS Karthikeya, has experienced a surge in public attention ahead of its October 2 theatrical rollout. Although the movie had maintained steady baseline awareness, mainstream discussions across Telugu film circles remained relatively modest until a recent shift.

The turning point arrived when Jr NTR stepped in to support the project by attending its promotional event. His sudden appearance generated immediate traction, pushing the title into major trending discussions across social media networks and instantly expanding its visibility among regional moviegoers.

Despite the successful promotional push, industry insiders note that audience turnout will ultimately depend on the film's intrinsic content. As a content-driven release, positive word of mouth remains vital to converting digital buzz into lasting box office success once the film hits theatres.
